Fishery (Part II) configuration

Source: R/config_fishery.R
om_fishery_config.Rd

Returns the full list of parameters of the pelagic longline fishery generator: fleets, vessels and their careers, trips, sets, effort (hooks), gear (hooks between floats, HBF), latent fishing strategies, spatial behaviour of the fleets (preferential sampling, fidelity, expansion), the components of log catchability, the catch process (Tweedie or delta-lognormal), companion species, observation profiles and the scenario data sets. The "BET_ICCAT" preset is the configuration of Experimento 02 (five fleets A-E, target BET, companions YFT, ALB, SWO, BSH, eight scenarios).

Usage

om_fishery_config(preset = "BET_ICCAT", ...)

validate_fishery_config(cfg)

Arguments

preset

Name of a preset (see om_presets()).

...

Optional named sections that override the preset, passed to om_config_update() (e.g. population = list(r = 0.4)).

cfg

A fishery configuration.

Value

A list of class om_fishery_config.

Details

Every stochastic component has its own seed (reproducibility$seeds), so that changing one process does not reshuffle the draws of the others.

Functions

  • validate_fishery_config(): Checks the internal coherence of a fishery configuration. Region names are checked later, against the biomass truth, by simulate_fishery().

See also

om_biomass_config(), simulate_fishery(), generate_scenarios().

Examples

fcfg <- om_fishery_config("BET_ICCAT")
names(fcfg$fleets)
#> [1] "A" "B" "C" "D" "E"
## halve the size of fleet A and switch off creep
fcfg2 <- om_fishery_config("BET_ICCAT",
                           fleets = list(A = list(n_vessels = 20)),
                           catchability = list(creep_enabled = FALSE))
fcfg2$fleets$A$n_vessels
#> [1] 20
